why: The answer covers all three required facts. 'Staff users' matches staff, and 'admins' matches administrators. 'The record's owner' conveys that a member can delete their own bookings, and because only owners are listed besides staff and admins, other members' bookings are implicitly excluded. No mustNot items apply.

The answer says members can delete only their own bookings and that cancelling on the My bookings page is open to them until the class starts, so both required facts are covered. It also says members cannot delete anyone else's bookings, so it does not claim members can delete other people's bookings.

The answer says "Yes" and says the schedule page opens without signing in, which is the same as visitors being able to open it without signing in. Both required facts are present and mustNot is empty.

The answer says a session never has more bookings than its capacity (12 by default) and that new bookings are refused with "No places left", which conveys the required fact that no more bookings than its capacity are allowed. No mustNot items exist, so none are violated.
The answer begins with "No" and states that members see only their own bookings on the My bookings page. Both required facts are present, and mustNot is empty, so nothing is violated.

The answer states all five required facts: class type, instructor, starts at (date and time), capacity (default 12), and places left (capacity minus bookings). It adds the bookings list, which is extra but not forbidden, and mustNot is empty.

The answer says it doesn't know and that the app only sends a sign-in code email. It never states that members get an email when a booking is made, and it never mentions a reminder the day before. It fails all three required facts: "yes", "a mail when the booking is made", and "a reminder the day before". It contradicts the first two by implying no booking email exists.

Svaret ger inget tydligt "nej" och säger inte att bara publicerade inlägg visas. Det säger i stället att det inte kan svara säkert och att utkast kan synas om filtrering saknas. Villkoret om where: { status: published } nämns, men svaret hävdar aldrig att besökare bara ser publicerade inlägg.

The answer says everyone who signs in can see other people's customers, and that every signed-in person sees all records. That conveys the 'shared' fact in different words. mustNot is empty, so the contradictory remark about who can edit or delete records does not count against it.

The answer states all three required facts: standard shipping is free when the total is over 100 EUR, standard costs 5 EUR otherwise (below 100), and express is 15 EUR. It contradicts nothing, and mustNot is empty.

Svaret anger att personer med en acme.example-adress kan logga in och att bara sådana adresser släpps in (adresser på acme.example). Det säger också att administratörer kan bjuda in personer på sidan Team, vilket motsvarar inbjudna kollegor. Inget under mustNot finns, så båda must-fakta täcks.

The answer says only the owner (account manager) can edit and delete a customer. That roughly matches "omat asiakkaansa", but it never mentions that administrators (ylläpitäjät) can also delete customers. One required fact is missing, so the answer is incomplete. It also says only the owner can delete, which contradicts the administrator permission.
Vastaus sanoo, että ajan voi perua viimeistään 12 tuntia ennen alkamisaikaa, mikä vastaa vaadittua tietoa "12 tuntia ennen". Kiellettyjä asioita ei ole.

The answer states Monday to Friday 09:00-17:00, Saturday 10:00-14:00, and a daily break from 12:00 to 12:30 on open days. All three required facts are present, and there are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer says "No", which covers the first must fact. It also says a booked slot is taken and that each appointment keeps 10 minutes free afterwards, so an appointment takes up the barber's time. It also says time offs block the barber's time. The mustNot list is empty, so nothing is violated.

Svaret säger "nej", så det första kravet är uppfyllt. Det andra kravet, "bara ledighet", saknas. Svaret säger att personalen ser både sidan Dagen och sidan Frånvaro, inte bara ledighet/frånvaro, och nämner aldrig att frisörer bara kan hantera ledighet.
The answer says an invoice becomes overdue 7 days after its due date and only if its status is still sent. Both required facts are stated, and there are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer says no, other users cannot see your clients, and explains that each user sees, changes and deletes only their own records. That covers both required facts. The admin exception does not contradict them, and mustNot is empty.

The answer mentions outstanding, overdue, paid and latest invoices, but it lists "invoiced" as a plain tile rather than "invoiced by month". The must list requires "invoiced by month", and the answer never says the invoiced figure is broken down by month, so that fact is missing. No mustNot items exist, so the failure comes only from this omission.
The answer states that once an invoice is sent or paid it can no longer be edited and the only option is to credit it, which covers the required fact. No mustNot conditions apply.

The answer covers two of the three required facts: staff users are notified, and the notification goes out by email and push. It never mentions the kitchen, which is the third required fact, so the answer is incomplete.

Svaret säger inte uttryckligen "nej" utan är osäkert om vem som kan se Orders-listan. Det anger att kunder bara skickar beställningar via sidan Order from the truck, men säger aldrig tydligt att besökare enbart kan skicka beställningar. Därför uppfylls inte båda måste-kraven.
The answer states that decline sets the order's status to declined and that it asks for the reason. Both required facts are present, and no mustNot conditions exist.

The answer never states the required facts. The must list needs "no" (visitors cannot see who is selling an item) and "the owner is not shown". The answer only says the app doesn't specify and that it doesn't know. That is an expression of uncertainty, not a statement that the owner is not shown. Its remark that the For sale page lets people contact the owner by mail also hints that the owner may be identifiable, which does not match the required facts.

The answer says photos are reviewed and the item waits until they are approved, which covers "photos wait for approval". It also says an admin approves or rejects them on the Review page, which covers "an administrator approves them". The mustNot list is empty, so nothing is violated.
The required fact is that only administrators can add items. The answer says anyone who signs in can add items because members can create their own records, which contradicts the required fact.

The answer says anyone without signing in can read incidents in all four states, which covers "all of them", and it lists investigating, identified, monitoring and resolved. No mustNot items exist, so none are violated.
The answer covers the Component and Incident models and the resolve action, but it never says the API is offered to AI assistants too. That fact is required under must, so the answer is incomplete.

Vastaus ei kerro mitään vaadituista faktoista: ei että tila muuttuu ratkaistuksi, ei että ratkaisuaika asetetaan, eikä että päivitys lisätään. Se toteaa vain, ettei määrittelystä selviä, mitä Resolve tekee, ja jättää kysymykseen vastaamatta.

The answer says yes, explains that a Slack slash command such as /incident creates (opens) an incident from the incoming call, and states the status is investigating. Every required fact is covered and there are no mustNot items.

The answer states all three required facts: a new SupportCase is created from the incoming mail, its status is set to open, and the customer is sent a mail titled "We got your request", which tells them the request was received. No mustNot items exist, so none can be violated.

The answer says anyone who can use the Cases page may close cases and that no particular role is required. It never says that agents and administrators are the ones who can close cases. It also mentions admins only in connection with the Team page, not as closers of cases. The required facts about agents and administrators are missing.
The answer says no, the email cannot be changed, and states that it is fixed once the case exists. That covers both required facts, and mustNot is empty.

The answer states that a case must have an assignee when its status is in progress or closed, which matches the required fact "när det pågår eller är stängt". No mustNot items exist, so the extra detail about open and reopened cases does not make it wrong.

The answer says no, the assistant cannot delete tasks, and states that its role never deletes (it only reads, adds and changes). Both required facts are present, and mustNot is empty, so nothing is violated.
The answer names all three required roles (admin, member, assistant) and states nothing that falls under mustNot, which is empty.

The answer fails the first must: it says nothing marks an invoice overdue by itself, but the facts say a sent invoice is marked overdue 7 days after its due date. It does state that mail goes out only when an invoice is marked sent, and it recommends Mark paid, so those two musts are covered. It also avoids claiming the client is mailed on overdue. Still, the denial of automatic overdue marking contradicts the required fact.

The answer states all three required facts: it cannot delete anything ("cannot delete anything... never deletes"), it can add and change tasks and notes, and it can read every record. No mustNot items apply.
